body_text: View All News Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. Completes Acquisition of Signature Bancorporation, Inc. on August 1, 2026 August 3, 2026 JERICHO, N.Y. , Aug. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: ESQ) ("Esquire"), the parent company of Esquire Bank, National Association, (collectively "Esquire") announced today the completion of the previously announced acquisition of Signature Bancorporation, Inc., the parent company of Signature Bank (collectively "Signature"), effective August 1, 2026. The combined company has approximately $4.8 billion in total assets, $3.3 billion in loans, and $4.0 billion in total deposits (based on financial information as of June 30, 2026). This combined company will join Esquire's established national litigation and payments verticals with Signature's established Chicago and Midwest commercial banking franchise, enhancing the company's continued industry-leading performance and growth metrics. "We are thrilled to welcome the Signature team, clients, and shareholders to Esquire," stated Tony Coelho, Chairman of the Board of Directors. "This combination brings together two institutions with highly complementary commercial banking operations and capabilities while uniting two highly talented management teams with strong client relationships and strong market expertise." "The Signature merger positions the combined company for continued industry-leading growth, performance metrics and enhanced success in the highly desirable Midwest and Chicago metropolitan markets with a well-established Chicago-based management team and brand," stated Andrew C. Sagliocca, Vice Chairman, Chief Executive Officer, and President. "Chicago represents one of the top three largest metro markets by both population and number of contingency fee law firms, with New York City and Los Angeles rounding out the top three." The former Signature Bank will operate as a division of Esquire Bank under the name "Signature, a division of Esquire Bank" (the "Division"). Michael G. O'Rourke will serve as President of the Division. Kevin P. Bastuga and Bryan D. Duncan will each serve as Executive Vice Presidents of the Division. Michael G. O'Rourke, President of Signature, a division of Esquire Bank, added, "This transaction was built on both companies' shared values and commitment to our clients. The combined company will continue to deliver enhanced value to all stakeholders while accelerating our growth in Chicago and the Midwest markets." In connection with the closing of the transaction, Mr. O'Rourke and Leonard S. Caronia, former Chairman of Signature's Board, were appointed to the Boards of Directors of Esquire. About Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. is a financial holding company headquartered in Jericho, New York. Its wholly owned subsidiary, Esquire Bank, is a full-service commercial bank, with branch offices in Jericho, New York, Los Angeles, California, Chicago, Illinois, as well as an administrative office in Boca Raton, Florida. The Bank is dedicated to serving the financial needs of the litigation industry and small businesses nationally, as well as commercial and retail customers in the New York, Los Angeles and Chicago metropolitan areas. The Bank offers tailored financial and payment processing solutions to the litigation community and their clients as well as dynamic and flexible payment processing solutions to small business owners. For more information, visit www.esquirebank.com . title: How to Choose the Right Business Desktop for Work on Newegg
summary: Learn how to choose a reliable, fast business desktop for office or home work on Newegg, with tips on specs, form factors, and value.
body_text: Shopping for a business desktop is really about finding the right balance of speed, reliability, and value. If your workday includes email, spreadsheets, video calls, browser tabs, and office apps, you do not need to overspend on a machine that is built for gaming or creative production. You just need a desktop that can keep up, stay dependable, and fit your workspace. That is where Newegg makes the process easier. With a broad selection of desktop computers, including compact office towers, all-in-one PCs, and higher-performance business systems, you can compare options in one place and quickly narrow down what makes sense for your team or home office. 1. Define the work first The best business desktop is the one that matches the job it is meant to do. A front-desk or reception PC may only need to handle web apps, email, and video meetings. A finance or operations user may spend the day in spreadsheets, dashboards, and dozens of tabs. If the workflow is more demanding, like design work or data-heavy tasks, you will want a stronger processor and more memory. For most business users, a solid starting point is a modern multi-core CPU, 16 GB of RAM, and a 512 GB SSD or larger. If you plan to run dual monitors, confirm that the desktop includes the right video connections such as HDMI and DisplayPort. And if your setup depends on wired networking, Gigabit Ethernet should be on the checklist. 2. Focus on the specs that matter most Business desktop shopping is easiest when you concentrate on the parts that affect daily performance. CPU, memory, storage, and connectivity have the biggest impact on how smooth the system feels during a normal workday. CPU: Choose a current-generation Intel Core or AMD Ryzen processor for responsive everyday performance. Memory: 16 GB is a strong starting point for multitasking; 32 GB can help for heavier office workflows. Storage: NVMe SSDs reduce boot and app-launch times compared with older hard drives. Ports: Look for USB-A, USB-C, and video outputs for monitors and peripherals. Security: Business-friendly features may include TPM support, BIOS protections, and cable-lock options. Form factor matters too. A small-form-factor desktop can be a smart pick when desk space is tight, while a tower usually gives you more room to upgrade later. An all-in-one can help reduce cable clutter, but it may offer less flexibility if you want to replace parts over time. 3. Match the desktop to the workplace If you are buying for a shared office, consistency can save time and headaches later. Choosing one or two desktop models makes support simpler, streamlines accessory ordering, and helps IT teams handle setup, imaging, and replacements more efficiently. For hybrid workers, a compact desktop can also serve as a clean home-office hub when paired with a dock, keyboard, mouse, and one or two displays. For small businesses, Newegg is a practical place to compare desktops by use case, price range, and configuration without starting from scratch. That makes it easier to stay within budget while still choosing a system that supports real day-to-day productivity. 4. Use Newegg to narrow the final choice Once you are ready to buy, Newegg helps you compare models side by side and check availability before you place the order. Product pages make it easier to verify the exact CPU, memory, storage, and ports so you know what is coming to the office. A good buying strategy is to compare at least three desktops in the same class, then choose the one that gives you the best mix of speed, expandability, and value. For business buyers, that usually means picking a system that handles today’s workload while leaving a little room to grow. Summary The best business desktop is not always the fastest or most expensive option. It is the one that is dependable, well-equipped, and a good fit for how your team works every day. Start with the workload, check the core specs, and use Newegg to compare the desktops that fit your office, home office, or small business setup. Frequently Asked Questions What should I prioritize first when buying a business desktop? Start with the workload, then match the CPU, memory, and storage to that need. For most office users, a current multi-core processor, 16 GB of RAM, and a 512 GB NVMe SSD are the most important baseline specs. How can I tell if a desktop supports dual monitors? Check the product specifications for HDMI, DisplayPort, or USB-C video output. You should also confirm that the system supports the number of displays and resolution you plan to use, since port availability alone is not always enough. Is a tower better than a small-form-factor desktop for work? A tower is usually the better choice if you want more upgrade flexibility over time. A small-form-factor desktop is often better when desk space is limited and you want a cleaner setup with fewer cables. How important are warranty and support for a business PC? They are very important because downtime can affect productivity for the whole team. A better warranty can make repairs, replacements, and support much easier if the desktop has an issue. Should I buy a new or refurbished desktop for business use? A refurbished desktop can be a good value if the seller is reputable and the hardware still meets your needs. A new desktop is usually the safer choice if you want a longer service life, newer platform features, and easier standardization across multiple employees. a Read More Newegg Business Desktop Computers — Newegg’s business desktop category lets you compare office-ready systems by form factor, CPU, and operating system. title: The Most Valuable Resource We Share in Meetings Isn’t Information. It’s Time.
summary: I have spent much of my career helping teams build trust and work together effectively. Along the way, I have learned an important lesson: productive collaboration starts long before the work itself. It starts with how we meet.
body_text: I have spent much of my career helping teams build trust and work together effectively. Along the way, I have learned an important lesson: productive collaboration starts long before the work itself. It starts with how we meet. That realization was reinforced recently while supporting a large cross-site project that brought together teams from different locations and working styles. As we prepared for the initiative, it became clear that success would depend on more than technical execution. We needed a shared understanding of how we would communicate and work together. That conversation led us to establish a set of meeting guidelines designed to create clarity, accountability, and respect for everyone’s time. Why Meeting Habits Matter Most professionals spend a significant portion of their workweek in meetings. Yet many leave those meetings without clear action items or next steps. In my view, meetings should increase productivity, not consume it. When employees walk out of a meeting wondering what they accomplished, organizations lose more than time. They lose momentum and focus. Good meeting habits help prevent that. They create clear expectations and improve preparation, ensuring participants understand why they are there and what success looks like. Building Trust Before Results One of the most important outcomes of effective meetings is not efficiency. It is trust. When teams are newly formed, employees are still learning how to work together. They are navigating different expectations and perspectives. Clear meeting practices help eliminate uncertainty. When agendas are defined and responsibilities are clear, employees can focus less on interpreting expectations and more on solving problems together. I have found that trust develops faster when teams have a shared framework for collaboration. Respecting Time Across a Global Organization Working across multiple locations also reinforced the importance of being intentional about scheduling. What might be a convenient meeting time for one employee may be the beginning or end of the workday for someone else. The teams I worked with demonstrated remarkable consideration for one another by actively discussing how meeting schedules would affect colleagues in different regions. That level of thoughtfulness matters. Respecting someone’s time is one of the simplest ways to demonstrate respect for the person. The Leadership Responsibility Leaders play a crucial role in shaping meeting culture. Employees notice whether leaders arrive prepared, stay on agenda, end on time, and define clear outcomes. They also notice when those practices are absent. Meeting habits are often reflections of leadership habits. Leaders who model effective behaviors help create teams that communicate more clearly and work together more effectively. Where to Start You do not need to transform every meeting overnight. Start with one improvement: Add an agenda. Define desired outcomes. Assign action items. End on time. Share notes afterward. Small shifts compound over time. The most successful teams I have worked with are not necessarily the teams that meet more often. They are the teams that make every meeting count. When we treat time as the valuable resource it is, we create space for better collaboration and stronger relationships, leading to better business outcomes. By Sylvia Jarest, Sr. Director, Human Resources

title: Netflix Releases Official Season 3 Trailer for Highly Anticipated Series 'Graveyard'
body_text: Netflix has released the official season 3 trailer for the highly anticipated series Graveyard , directed by Abdullah Oğuz , starring Birce Akalay and Olgun Toker . The new season reunites Inspector Önem and her team, and will premiere only on Netflix, on August 28 . To download new images from the series, click HERE To download the first images from the series, click HERE The series is produced by Abdullah Oğuz and Evren Oğuz , with Abdullah Oğuz and Ömer Baykul sharing directing duties on the new season. The screenplay is written by Fulya Turhan , Ahmet Saatçioğlu , and Evren Oğuz . The cast of the third season includes Birce Akalay and Olgun Toker, joined by Şehsuvar Aktaş, Hakan Meriçliler, Sezgin Uzunbekiroğlu, Cem Sürgit, Baran Güler, Arbil Tabur, Yeşim Çelebi, Elif Sevinç , and Berke Gündem . The team reunites to uncover the truth behind the mysterious boxes sent to women, embarking on the search for a shocking truth in the new season of Graveyard. Inspector Önem, meanwhile, finds both her team and herself at the center of a dark threat. About Graveyard Season 3: When a disturbing new case draws the disbanded Graveyard team back together, Önem’s unexpected return to duty turns the investigation into a personal and shattering process for the team. title: Honeywell Technologies Announces Leadership Updates for Process Technology and Building Automation
summary: Appointment of Honeywell Technologies veterans will strengthen leadership across the company’s businesses and support its long-term growth outlook Billal Hammoud transitions to serve as President and CEO of Process Technology, part of the company’s Process Automation & Technology (PA&T) reportable
body_text: Honeywell Technologies Announces Leadership Updates for Process Technology and Building Automation Aug 19, 2026 Appointment of Honeywell Technologies veterans will strengthen leadership across the company’s businesses and support its long-term growth outlook Billal Hammoud transitions to serve as President and CEO of Process Technology, part of the company’s Process Automation & Technology (PA&T) reportable business segment Juan Picon, formerly President of highly successful Building Automation (BA) Americas business, will succeed Hammoud as President and CEO of Building Automation CHARLOTTE, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 19, 2026-- Honeywell Technologies (Nasdaq: HON) announced the appointment of Billal Hammoud as President and CEO of Process Technology, a component of the company’s Process Automation & Technology reportable business segment, effective Oct. 1, 2026. A veteran of Honeywell Technologies, Hammoud will succeed Ken West who is leaving the company to pursue an external opportunity as of Aug. 31, 2026. Juan Picon, President of Building Automation Americas, will succeed Hammoud as President and CEO of Building Automation, also effective Oct. 1, 2026. Hammoud and Picon will both report to Vimal Kapur, Chairman and CEO of Honeywell Technologies. “Billal elevated Building Automation into one of our clearest examples of accelerated growth, disciplined transformation, customer-centered execution and new product innovation. His deep experience in strategy execution, track record of driving operational rigor to deliver strong results and successful M&A integration ─ including our $4.95 billion acquisition of Access Solutions ─ makes him the ideal choice to lead Process Technology into its next phase of growth and profitability. “Juan brings more than two decades of Honeywell Technologies experience combining measurable business impact with a clear commitment to our customers and culture. Most recently, he led the creation of a regional structure in the Americas, pivoted the business towards higher growth verticals such as healthcare, hospitality and data centers and accelerated the adoption of Forge to deliver strong results,” said Vimal Kapur, Chairman and CEO of Honeywell Technologies. "Both Billal and Juan’s appointments demonstrate the depth and strength of our leadership bench across Honeywell Technologies,” added Kapur. “We are also grateful to Ken for his contributions and his leadership in helping position Process Technology for future growth over the long term and wish him every success in his new endeavor.” About Billal Hammoud Since 2023, Hammoud has served as President and CEO of Building Automation, transforming the business by accelerating annual organic growth* from 2% in 2023 to 8% in 2025. With a sharper focus on higher-growth verticals, empowering local teams through a regional structure and bringing innovative new products to customers, including Honeywell Technologies Forge Connected Buildings, Hammoud led Building Automation to seven consecutive quarters of high-single-digit organic growth and margin expansion. Prior to leading Building Automation, Hammoud served as President and General Manager of Smart Energy and Thermal Solutions for Honeywell Technologies Performance Materials and Technologies, leading a portfolio focused on energy management, electrification and thermal solutions. Earlier in his career, he held senior leadership roles including Vice President and General Manager of Thermal Solutions and Vice President and General Manager of Combustion Controls. Outside of Honeywell Technologies, Hammoud held leadership roles at ESAB (formerly part of Colfax). He holds an MBA and a B.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering from Wayne State University. About Juan Picon Since rejoining Honeywell Technologies in 2024 as President of the Fire Life Safety business, Picon has continued to expand his leadership impact across the company. As President of Building Automation Americas, he has strengthened customer engagement throughout the region while increasing the business' focus on higher-growth verticals. Prior to returning to Honeywell Technologies in 2024, Picon served in executive leadership roles at Sensata Technologies, WESCO Distribution and General Cable. Picon previously spent more than 18 years at Honeywell Technologies in a variety of leadership positions across the company’s business segments, including its automation and controls business. His accomplishments earned him the company’s annual Chairman’s Award in 2025, the highest recognition awarded to employees for superior performance. He holds an MBA from Arizona State University, a master’s degree in European Union Law from the University of Carlos III of Madrid, a Diploma in Business from the Centro de Estudios de Comercio of Madrid and a Law degree from the University Complutense of Madrid. About Honeywell Technologies Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.
